text_block_list.text:
Кинг Хало fails to finish first. But despite
her
great disappointment, she heads to
the concert
stage together with Seiun
Sky.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
The Arima Kinen is the last race of the
year, which
makes this is the last
opportunity to show her
gratitude to her
fans.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
The winning concert they perform is the
most
exciting of the year.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
